name: – Marjan Šarec – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Montenegro
part_text:
The European Parliament says Montenegro is the closest candidate country to joining the EU and urges it to keep reforming. It calls for faster, fairer courts, real results against corruption and organised crime, and better protection of media, minorities and women. It also asks the EU to help Montenegro resist foreign interference and disinformation. The report does not change any law; it sets out the Parliament's opinion and its requests to Montenegro and the EU.

- Montenegro must show final convictions in high-level corruption and crime cases.
- It affects Montenegro's government, courts, media and citizens, plus EU institutions.
- Next, Montenegro is urged to finish reforms and close talks by end of 2026.
